variants.title: Half adder from NAND gates
variants.unknown: the sum and carry truth table of the half adder
variants.note: Sum = A xor B (four NAND gates), carry = A.B (two more).

source.title: Texas Instruments SN5400/SN7400 datasheet (SDLS025); M. Morris Mano, Digital Design, adders

variants.title: Full adder from NAND gates
variants.unknown: the sum and carry truth table of the full adder
variants.note: Two half adders in cascade with their carries combined, so eight rows instead of four.

source.title: Texas Instruments SN5400/SN7400 datasheet (SDLS025); M. Morris Mano, Digital Design, adders

variants.title: 4-bit ripple-carry adder from full adders
variants.unknown: the four-bit sum and the final carry
variants.sample: Four full adders chained (3 x SN7400 per stage on the trainer)
variants.note: Each stage's carry out feeds the next stage's carry in, so the answer is only right once the carry has rippled all the way along.

source.title: Texas Instruments SN5400/SN7400 datasheet (SDLS025); M. Morris Mano, Digital Design, ripple-carry adder
